metal_donor_distances.format: Space-delimited: residue atom metal avg_bond_dist st_dev. Column 1 'CA' is the backbone-carbonyl pseudo residue, not calcium; column 3 'CA' is calcium.

metallocofactors.format: Tab-delimited: component id, formula, structural class (cluster, heme, or empty).
